title: Reviewing the code and trying hybrid retrieval

cues.en: So we have the search method over in the Postgres store, pretty much done in this file postgres.py.
cues.zh: postgres.py 中 PostgresStore 的 search 方法大致完成了。

cues.en: As I was editing the last lecture, I discovered at least one typographical error.
cues.zh: 剪輯上一堂課時，我發現至少一個打字錯誤，

cues.en: There's probably more.
cues.zh: 可能還有更多。

cues.en: In my case, it's in this, not the first, second, or third.
cues.zh: 我的錯不在第一、第二或第三段，

cues.en: So it's not the first part, not the first SQL query, or the second one, or the third one.
cues.zh: 所以不是第一個 SQL 查詢，也不是第二或第三個，

cues.en: It's in the fourth one.
cues.zh: 而是在第四個，

cues.en: It's right here.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: When I'm joining documents D, I'm joining on di.d, but we have no alias di.
cues.zh: JOIN documents d 時，我寫成 di.d，但根本沒有 di 這個別名，

cues.en: We have one d for documents, okay?
cues.zh: documents 的別名只有 d。

cues.en: So that one's fixed.
cues.zh: 現在修好了。

cues.en: Now let's go through this one more time, and then we'll give it a try, okay?
cues.zh: 再完整看一次，然後測試。

cues.en: So to start with, right at the beginning, we initially get our connection.
cues.zh: 一開始先取得連線，

cues.en: No problem there.
cues.zh: 這沒有問題。

cues.en: Then we set up two variables.
cues.zh: 然後建立兩個變數，

cues.en: We give them default values.
cues.zh: 給它們預設值，

cues.en: The number of candidates we wanna get back from one of our searches, and that'll be 20 for us, because we have our top case set to five, so four times five is 20, but it'll be 20.
cues.zh: 一個是每次搜尋要取得的候選數，這裡是 20，因為 top_k 設為 5，4 乘 5 就是 20。

cues.en: And then our FK, which is the reciprocal rank fusion K, we set that to 60, just so we'll have some overlapping results, okay?
cues.zh: 另一個是 RRF 的 k，也就是倒數排名融合常數，設為 60，讓我們能取得重疊結果。

cues.en: Otherwise, our hybrid retrieval is just not going to work very well.
cues.zh: 否則混合檢索就不會有太好的效果。

cues.en: If we limit everything to five, it's just not gonna work, and we're better off with a pure dense search.
cues.zh: 如果全部都限制成五筆，效果不好，還不如只做稠密向量搜尋。

cues.en: Now this used to be a pure dense search, and it still has a pure dense search.
cues.zh: 原本只有稠密向量搜尋，現在依然保留它，

cues.en: The only difference is we're doing this first one, the semantic search, okay?
cues.zh: 差別只是先執行第一個語意搜尋。

cues.en: So we select a bunch of rows here, and we go over them, ordering by distance as rank, and then we select things from that, okay?
cues.zh: 選取一些資料列，依距離排序、產生排名，再從裡面選取資料。

cues.en: And we have this all stored in an alias S for semantic search.
cues.zh: 全部儲存在 s 這個語意搜尋別名裡。

cues.en: Then we do the lexical search, and this is the new one.
cues.zh: 接著做詞彙搜尋，這是新增的部分。

cues.en: This is the one that actually looks for the column, content underscore TSV, and we saw that over in our Postgres, okay?
cues.zh: 它會使用 content_tsv 欄位，之前已在 Postgres 看過，

cues.en: And that has some words extracted from the text that we can search on those.
cues.zh: 裡面有從文字抽出的詞彙，可供搜尋。

cues.en: And of course, where does that content TSV come from?
cues.zh: 那 content_tsv 從哪裡來？

cues.en: Well, if we look at this in its SQL, okay?
cues.zh: 看看 init.sql，

cues.en: Down here, these three indices, okay?
cues.zh: 下面這三個索引，

cues.en: These are the ones that take care of getting all things indexed.
cues.zh: 它們負責替內容建立索引。

cues.en: And the one in particular that we're talking about right now is chunks content TSV gin, okay?
cues.zh: 特別是現在要談的 chunks_content_tsv_gin，

cues.en: This one creates that column. Perfect.
cues.zh: 這個會建立那個欄位。很好。

cues.en: So let's close this, go back to our code.
cues.zh: 關掉這個，回到程式碼。

cues.en: So we do our semantic search, we do our lexical search, then we use union all to fuse them into one dataset, okay?
cues.zh: 執行語意搜尋、詞彙搜尋，再用 UNION ALL 融合為一個資料集，

cues.en: And then we select from that fused dataset.
cues.zh: 然後從融合後的資料集選取。

cues.en: That's the only thing we're doing here, okay?
cues.zh: 我們只做這件事。

cues.en: We did some playing with metadata down here, okay?
cues.zh: 下面也調整了 metadata，

cues.en: Because we need to have this kind of information available for the search to work properly.
cues.zh: 因為搜尋需要這類資訊才能正常運作。

cues.en: And we'll be doing more with metadata in the next section.
cues.zh: 下一節會進一步處理 metadata。

cues.en: But this is, even though it's a lot of SQL, it's not that complex, okay?
cues.zh: 雖然 SQL 很多，但不複雜。

cues.en: We're basically extending dense search by combining it with lexical search, and then searching the union of those two datasets for our final projection, for our final output,
cues.zh: 基本上就是把稠密向量搜尋與詞彙搜尋結合，擴充搜尋能力，再從兩個資料集的合併結果取得最後投影、最後輸出，

cues.en: what we wanna select our top K from.
cues.zh: 也就是從裡面選出前 k 筆。

cues.en: That's all we're doing.
cues.zh: 做的就是這些。

cues.en: Now, the moment of truth.
cues.zh: 現在是驗證成果的時刻，

cues.en: Let's open up our code and let's type pyreg chat, okay?
cues.zh: 開啟終端機，輸入 pyrag chat，

cues.en: And I'm gonna ask the same question that failed last time.
cues.zh: 再問上次失敗的同一個問題，

cues.en: What is a pyrexel?
cues.zh: 「什麼是 Quirexal？」

cues.en: And now it's going to use our new hybrid retrieval hybrid search functionality.
cues.zh: 現在它會使用新的混合檢索、混合搜尋功能。

cues.en: Let's see what happens.
cues.zh: 看看會發生什麼，

cues.en: So it's thinking.
cues.zh: 它正在思考，

cues.en: And it found the information.
cues.zh: 找到資訊了。

cues.en: And you can see that it actually got most of its results from guardian text, and it chose a few from vampire, okay?
cues.zh: 可以看到大部分結果都來自 guardian.txt，也選了幾筆 vampire 的內容，

cues.en: But we got a meaningful response, and that's exactly the sort of output I hope to see.
cues.zh: 但得到有意義的回覆，這正是我希望看到的輸出。

cues.en: Perfect, so this seems to work reasonably well.
cues.zh: 很好，看起來效果相當不錯。

cues.en: So let's move on now to metadata.
cues.zh: 接著處理 metadata，

cues.en: Let's implement adding some metadata to our content, okay?
cues.zh: 實作替內容加入一些中繼資料，

cues.en: So let's move on.
cues.zh: 我們繼續。
